usage: relatum [-h] {init,new,ls,get,supersede,check} ...

Pass-by-reference notes for agent swarms.

positional arguments:
  {init,new,ls,get,supersede,check}
    init                create .swarmnotes/ with a default report format
    new                 create a note (body from --body or stdin)
    ls                  list notes: id, kind, summary
    get                 print note bodies, following superseded_by
    supersede           mark OLD as replaced by NEW
    check               lint every note

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
